about_item: Light Size: Dazzle Bright fairy lights comes with 60 LED bulbs. Bright lights exude a 360 degrees charming light, add a festival glow to your home. The fairy lights is 20 ft, bulb spacing is 3.7 inch

Remote Control: The fairy lights can be controlled with 44 key wireless remote. There are 24 different color options and 6 lighting modes (fade, dump, in waves, strobe, twinkle, breathing). It also has 3 timer modes, "4H" (4 hours on/20 hours off), "6H" (6 hours on/18 hours off), "8H" (8 hours on/16 hours off), "TIMER OFF", the timer will be canceled. Press "DIM-" and "DIM+" can adjust brightness. Press "SPEED-" and "SPEED+" can adjust speed

Battery Operated & USB: Requires 3 AA batteries for power supply, which consumes little power and can stay bright for a long time without worrying about dimming. Also the lights powered by USB normally, equipped with a USB transfer to adapter. Note: When the battery box and USB are connected , the USB power supply will be used without the battery

Waterproof: Our lights are IP44 waterproof, can withstand rain, light up well in rainy weather outside, ideal decorative light string for indoor and outdoor. Note: Please keep the USB plug and battery box away from the water
Widely Application: Creating a winter fairy kingdom belong to you with fairy lights. Perfect for indoor, home, garden, lawn, courtyards, stairs, front door, Christmas tree, fence decorations

summary.text: Customers find the string lights wonderfully bright with a warm blue glow, and one customer mentions they're bright enough to see through multiple layers of colored fabric. However, the color quality receives mixed feedback, with some praising the variety of patterns and colors while others report inconsistent color distribution along the string. Moreover, the reliability and durability are concerning, with multiple customers reporting that 3/4 of the lights don't work and that they only last a week. Additionally, the battery life and value for money are mixed aspects, with some finding them great for the price while others say they're not worth the money and go through batteries quickly.

authors_reviews.title: Great Product!
authors_reviews.text: I use the wall plug in vs batteries and havent had any issues!
authors_reviews.author: Dillon

authors_reviews.title: Love it!
authors_reviews.text: Easy to set up, great variety of colors and effects.
authors_reviews.author: Sandra E. Godbout

authors_reviews.title: Cool light overall
authors_reviews.text: These lights are pretty neat. I got them specifically to wrap around the top bar of my bedframe. I just use some tape and attached the battery box to the side of my bed Post. They’re OK. I will say that they are extremely easy to get very tangled and it takes a while to get them untangled which was frustrating. But aside from that I just don’t like the color that it emits. I thought it was more of a black light, but it’s not. It’s just extremely bright purple LEDs. Not really the look I was going for but fun nonetheless.
authors_reviews.author: Christopher

authors_reviews.title: Love Fairy Lights!!
authors_reviews.text: Anyone who knows me, knows that I love Fairy lights. I absolutely love these because you can plug them in using a USB cord which makes it so much easier because let me tell you the battery life is not good on these. I kept having to replace them at least daily. But once I figured out the plug situation, they work amazing and they are beautiful.
authors_reviews.author: Holly Cerutti

authors_reviews.title: Lights so severely knotted and tangled they broke in half
authors_reviews.text: Lights are pretty and seemingly packaged well however when attempting to unravel them, it seems whoever packaged them twisted and looped the strings in all different directions and getting them untangled was like trying to get thin black bread ties that were knotted by an angry toddler untangled. Literally impossible. I spent 45 minutes trying to get ONE of the four fairy lights untangled only for half of the light strings to break off because it was so knotted. Very disappointed as at this point it's too late to wait to receive more lights and put them up before it's too late. Happy Halloween i guess
authors_reviews.author: Haleigh

authors_reviews.title: Disappointed.
authors_reviews.text: I like them, a lot, but only one worked once I installed it. Kinda bummed. I even tested it before I strung it up and it worked. Not sure what happened. At least the other one worked.
authors_reviews.author: Angela Avilez

authors_reviews.title: Good buy!
authors_reviews.text: Very bright. Batteries last a long time. Been a month using timer with lights on for 6 hours a day and they are still going strong and bright.
authors_reviews.author: Amazon Customer
